evidence: Lothar of Segni (Innocent III), De miseria condicionis humane: nam crūdēlitās parit odium, et familiāritās parit contemptum
terms.comment: A medieval proverb, in medieval moralists; the letter on study ascribed to Thomas Aquinas has nimia familiāritās parit contemptum. We have found no ancient source.
Literally “close company produces contempt”: Traupman’s form, with conversātiō for familiāritās.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Lothar of Segni, De miseria condicionis humane, and the Epistola de modo studendi, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
